title: Circuit test modulus
statement: Let $C$ be an arithmetic circuit, let $s$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j$ be a natural number. The test modulus at $j$ is one plus the value of the $j$th block of $s$, with blocks of length twice the modulus parameter determined by the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: The block length is twice the modulus parameter determined by $C$'s size
